name: Vophsi
overview: Vophsi is a male figure from the tribe of Naphtali mentioned in the book of Numbers. He is primarily known as the father of Nahbi. There are no additional notes or details about his life or character beyond this relationship.
namesAndTitles: The name Vophsi appears as a proper name in Scripture without any given meaning or special title. It is simply recorded as Vophsi in Numbers 13:14.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Vophsi as the father of Nahbi and as a descendant of the tribe of Naphtali. Beyond these relationships, no further family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Vophsi's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his role as the father of Nahbi, who is listed among the spies sent to explore the land of Canaan. This connection places Vophsi within the context of Israel's wilderness journey and the tribal representation during this critical event. Though Vophsi himself is not directly involved in the narrative, his mention underscores the importance of family lineage and tribal identity in God's providential plan for Israel.
